title: SteerCA: reinforcement learning environments for controlling cellular automata
description:
SteerCA is a framework of reinforcement learning environments in which an agent steers a cellular automaton by acting on the cell it stands on, racing the automaton's own dynamics. Every action costs automaton time, so the cost of acting is a continuous difficulty axis set by construction. This release contains the Firebreak forest-fire suite (batched GPU environments in TorchRL, a barrier planner as the reference, and planted instances with certified optima), PPO/A2C/SAC training, paired evaluation, an API for building new automata, and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table of the accompanying papers.

The trained policies and training logs are archived separately: 10.5281/zenodo.23328417.
